posts.body_en: Introducing ZYK / ZhiAn YunKe: institutional AI for education. We are developing an approach that connects school knowledge, useful AI tools, governance and teacher capability. Explore the direction at zykai.net.
posts.body_zh_cn: 认识ZYK（智安云科）：面向教育的机构级AI。我们正在探索将校本知识、实用AI工具、治理与教师能力建设相结合的方法。了解我们的方向：zykai.net。

posts.body_en: ZYK grows from our founder’s 30+ years in education, across teaching, leadership, curriculum and international settings. Earlier work, including Oxbridge College, is part of that history—not a rebranding of those organisations.
posts.body_zh_cn: ZYK源自创始人三十多年的教育经历，涵盖教学、领导力、课程与国际教育环境。Oxbridge College等早期工作是这段经历的一部分，并非将原有机构更名为ZYK。

posts.body_en: Start with one school problem, not every AI feature. Define who will use it, what data it needs, who reviews the results and how success will be measured. That is the pilot-first approach ZYK is developing.
posts.body_zh_cn: 从一个学校的实际问题出发，而不是一次追求所有AI功能。明确使用者、数据需求、人工复核责任与成功标准。这是ZYK正在发展的试点优先方法。

posts.body_en: An AI answer should connect to the school’s approved curriculum, policies and rubrics—with access boundaries and sources that people can check. This is the thinking behind ZYK Knowledge, currently in development.
posts.body_zh_cn: AI回答应与学校认可的课程、政策和评分标准相联系，并具有明确的访问边界和可核查的来源。这是开发中的ZYK Knowledge所遵循的思路。

posts.body_en: Useful school AI starts with people who can question, check and adapt its output. ZYK’s training direction focuses on practical teaching and institutional responsibility, not simply learning another tool.
posts.body_zh_cn: 有价值的校园AI离不开能够质疑、核查和调整其输出的人。ZYK的培训方向聚焦教学实践与机构责任，而不只是学会另一个工具。

posts.body_en: Our principle: AI may assist feedback and school workflows, but consequential educational decisions need accountable human judgement. We are designing ZYK around that boundary.
posts.body_zh_cn: 我们的原则：AI可以协助反馈与学校工作流，但重要教育决策需要由人做出并承担责任。ZYK的设计围绕这一边界展开。

posts.body_en: Models change. A school’s identity, knowledge, permissions and responsibilities should not depend on one model. ZYK is exploring infrastructure that keeps those institutional foundations in place as AI evolves.
posts.body_zh_cn: 模型会变化，但学校的身份、知识、权限与责任不应依赖单一模型。ZYK正在探索能够随AI演进而保持机构基础稳定的基础设施。

posts.body_en: What is one school workflow you would improve with AI—and what would make you trust it? ZYK welcomes conversations about practical needs, bounded pilots and responsible implementation. Contact hello@zykai.net.
posts.body_zh_cn: 您最希望用AI改善哪一项学校工作流？什么条件才能让您信任它？ZYK欢迎围绕实际需求、有限范围试点与负责任的实践开展交流。联系：hello@zykai.net。
